release_summary: First open-source release of the line-side reporting and first-response touchscreen console.
features: Station-specific failure selection and local-first incident reporting
Response coordination, repair timing and capability-based connectors
Responsive kiosk screens, meaningful animation and optional original sounds
Signed offline updates, protected Settings and structured operational logs
Public initial Settings access with installation-local password changes
fixes: Update availability and release links use the canonical public repository
Clearer station badges, timer spacing and modal backgrounds
Native-resolution screenshots and independently checked touchscreen layouts
Managed direct launches retain the correct deployment data root
Robust connector error handling for JSON arrays and scalar responses
Select the newest compatible signed USB release across multiple drives or version folders
security: Credential-free distribution with strict connector validation
Verified update signatures, artifact digests and build-input fingerprints
Changed local passwords replace initial access across every protected control
Retained signed update evidence is revalidated before activation
Offline transport guards, redacted errors and source-matched publication auditing
Bind approval to version and payload; reauthenticate cached metadata and exclude failed rollback targets
